 The State (Govt. Of Nct Of Delhi) .

Through: Mr. Aman Usman, App for 
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Amit Sharma
 Order

The present application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of the applicant,
seeks regular bail in case FIR no. 824/2021, under Sections 363/376 IPC & 6 POCSO Act, registered at PS Jahangir Puri, Delhi.
After some arguments, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant seeks leave to withdraw the present application.
The present application is dismissed as withdrawn and disposed of accordingly.
Pending application(s), if any, also stand disposed of.
